rules.name: Cross-Currency Triangulation
rules.logic: Convert non-USD currencies (EUR, GBP, JPY) to base USD via triangulation with 6 decimal place precision.

rules.name: Tiered Sliding Scale Fee Calculation
rules.logic: Amounts <= $1,000 incur 1.5% fee; $1,001-$10,000 incur 1.0%; > $10,000 incur 0.5% volume discount fee.

rules.name: AML Sanctioned Entity Blacklist Verification
rules.logic: Transactions involving sanctioned entities (e.g. SANCT_CORP_09) are immediately rejected with zero balance mutation.

rules.name: Account Balance Maximum Overflow Protection
rules.logic: Account credits that exceed $1,000,000 maximum threshold trigger immediate transaction rollback.

rules.name: Settlement Batch Ledger Report Generation
rules.logic: Aggregates settled credits, debits, rejected counts, and total fee revenue into formatted report lines.
